test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
How many squares are there in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/219924365c3d030149b92878afdf911b472bff8db5fa636db506527b469714a8.png]
solution:
The number of squares in the given figure is shown below :

1) Number of squares are = 12 + 22 ⇒ 5

As there are 2 same figures, therefore = (5 × 2) → 10 squares

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77cc2cf9065a5d8c0bd3b020756c749850dd2fee07082b15003cf8a90b82cf9e.png] 

2) Number of squares are = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af6b9752fdc495446a5be05d04b1160f02b35dc57408fceb48606a1849fa2554.png] 

Thus, as marked there are a total of (10 + 2) = 12 squares.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
